name: Sunset Grand Hotel
line: A pastel tower on the beach. Rooftop bar, 300 rooms, always booked.
shot: A pastel pink art deco beach hotel tower with a glowing rooftop bar, palm trees and a quiet beach promenade in front of it.

name: Skyline Penthouse
line: The top floor of the tallest tower in the city.
shot: A luxury glass penthouse terrace with an infinity pool and lounge chairs on top of a skyscraper, a bay skyline far below.

name: Coral Key
line: A private island ten minutes off the coast.
shot: Aerial view of a small private tropical island with one modern white villa, palm trees, white sand and turquoise water around it.

name: Hilltop Mansion
line: Twelve bedrooms and one view: the whole city.
shot: A modern hilltop mansion with floor-to-ceiling glass walls and a lit infinity pool, the city lights far below.

name: Marina Docks
line: Forty berths. Every yacht in town parks here.
shot: A marina full of white yachts moored at wooden docks, harbour lamps reflecting on calm water.

name: Starlight Motel
line: Neon sign, a pool, no questions asked.
shot: A retro roadside motel with a glowing neon star on a tall pole, a turquoise pool and palm trees.

name: Warehouse Lofts
line: An old warehouse full of new money.
shot: Converted red brick warehouse lofts with tall industrial windows glowing warm over a quiet cobbled street.

name: Boardwalk Pier
line: A ferris wheel and the best sunsets in town.
shot: A boardwalk pier over the ocean with a lit ferris wheel and small amusement rides, lights reflecting on the water.

name: Afterglow Nightclub
line: Doors open at midnight. The line goes round the block.
shot: The entrance of an upscale nightclub glowing with pink and violet neon light, a velvet rope, reflections on the wet street.

name: Last Call Bar
line: Every deal in the city closes here.
shot: Inside a moody cocktail bar: backlit bottle shelves, a polished brass bar top and one pink cocktail in a coupe glass.

name: Shine Car Wash
line: Every car in the city gets cleaned here. Every car.
shot: A modern drive-through car wash tunnel with colourful foam brushes and neon light, a glossy dark car inside.

name: Midnight Diner
line: Open 24 hours. Pancakes, coffee and gossip.
shot: A classic chrome 1950s roadside diner with glowing windows and pink neon trim, a vintage car parked outside.

name: Neon Arcade
line: High scores and higher rollers.
shot: Inside a neon arcade with rows of glowing cabinet machines in a pink and blue haze.

name: Anchor Tattoo
line: Walk-ins welcome. Regrets not refunded.
shot: Inside a stylish tattoo studio: a black leather chair, framed ink drawings on the walls, warm lamp light.

name: Three Ball Pawn
line: We buy anything. We ask nothing.
shot: A pawn shop counter with glass cases full of gold watches, rings and chains, electric guitars hanging on the wall behind.

name: Late Night Tacos
line: Parked outside the club at 3 AM. Always.
shot: A late-night taco truck with string lights and a glowing service window, steam rising, on a quiet street corner.

name: Nightfall GT
line: A V12 supercar. Zero to sixty before you blink.
shot: A sleek unbranded modern sports coupe in pearl white parked on a coastal road with the ocean behind.

name: Thunder Muscle
line: Loud, fast, and pulled over a lot.
shot: A classic unbranded American muscle car in deep purple parked under city street lights.

name: Street Bike
line: Splits lanes. Splits the bill.
shot: An unbranded sport motorcycle parked on a wet street reflecting neon light.

name: Stretch Limo
line: Arrive like the client.
shot: A black stretch limousine parked in front of a luxury hotel entrance with warm lights.

name: Offshore Speedboat
line: Twin engines and no brakes.
shot: An offshore racing speedboat cutting across a calm bay throwing white spray, a skyline in the distance.

name: Superyacht
line: Helipad, hot tub, crew of twenty.
shot: A white superyacht anchored in turquoise water with its deck lights on.

name: Private Jet
line: Wheels up whenever you say.
shot: A white private business jet on an airport apron with its stairs down, runway lights glowing.

name: City Helicopter
line: Skip traffic. Forever.
shot: A sleek dark helicopter on a rooftop helipad above a city skyline, landing lights on.
